Handle Ctrl+D in interactive prompts gracefully

dialoguer's interact_on() internally calls interact_on_opt().unwrap(),
which panics when the user presses Ctrl+D (EOF) or Escape. Switch to
interact_on_opt() for Confirm, Select, and MultiSelect prompts, and
return BivvyError::PromptCancelled instead of panicking.

Also fix prompt_yes_no to restore the cursor on read_key failure
before returning the cancellation error.
EOF
)"

    Handle Ctrl+D in interactive prompts gracefully
    
    dialoguer's interact_on() internally calls interact_on_opt().unwrap(),
    which panics when the user presses Ctrl+D (EOF) or Escape. Switch to
    interact_on_opt() for Confirm, Select, and MultiSelect prompts, and
    return BivvyError::PromptCancelled instead of panicking.

    before returning the cancellation error.
